Photo 1 shows the gearbox packed inside an open cardboard box with protective plastic; the gearbox body and mounting faces are visible but no clear brand/model plate is readable in this photo.

identity.brand: MARKS UG OCHUKWU (as written on photo 0 label)

claims.claim: Radicom gear box size 60 for production of fufu and different machine etc
claims.evidence: Photo 0 label shows “GEARBOX” and “TYPE: WP060-20-B” but does not clearly show “Radicom” or “size 60”; photo 1 does not show a readable brand/model plate.

risks.risk: Wrong gearbox model/ratio or mismatch with the machine the buyer needs (even if it’s a gearbox, the exact type matters).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the gearbox nameplate/label on the metal body showing brand, type (WP060-20-B), and ratio (20), plus a photo of the output shaft and mounting pattern.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as the gearbox may not match the buyer’s intended machine (worst-case: treated as not guaranteed compatible).

risks.risk: Unknown working condition (may be damaged, seized, missing oil, or have worn bearings/gears). Photos only show packaging and external appearance.
risks.proof: Video of the gearbox running (or hand-spin test) showing smooth rotation, no grinding/noise, and a photo of oil level/condition (if accessible) or drain plug area.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not confirmed working (worst-case: treated as for parts/needs service).

risks.risk: Missing parts/accessories (coupling, mounting bolts, oil seals, vent cap, or output key) that affect installation.
risks.proof: Photo inventory: show everything included in the box (all loose parts) laid out, and a close-up of the output shaft end (keyway/key) and any ports/caps.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown contents (worst-case: buyer may need to source missing parts).

risks.risk: Shipping/handling damage (cracks, bent mounting flanges, damaged seals) not visible from these angles.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all edges, mounting faces, seal areas, and any visible casting marks; include a photo of the gearbox feet/flange alignment surfaces.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially damaged externally (worst-case: needs inspection/repair).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the gearbox metal nameplate showing brand, type (WP060-20-B), and ratio (20).
Video of the gearbox being rotated/running (or at minimum a hand-spin test) showing smooth movement and no abnormal noise.
Photos of the output shaft end (keyway/key) and mounting pattern/bolt holes.
Photo of all items included in the box laid out (confirm no missing accessories).
Photos of seal areas and mounting faces to check for cracks/bends.
response.reason: The photos let me identify it as a gearbox type WP060-20-B (photo 0), but the seller’s compatibility/usage claim and the working condition are not provable remotely from these images. Without proof of condition and exact match, pricing would be guesswork.
